# GitHub Copilot Instructions

See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root for the canonical agent
instructions used by all coding agents in this project — including Copilot,
Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Aider, and others.

ColdVox standardizes on the [AGENTS.md convention](https://agents.md/).
This file is retained only as a thin shim for tools that look for
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` directly.
